{{Short description|None}}
The '''World Junior Records''' in [[Swimming (sport)|Swimming]] are ratified by [[World Aquatics]].<ref name="Swimming World Magazine"/> They are the fastest times recorded by a swimmer aged 14 to 18 years,  as of 31 December of the year of competition.<ref name=age/>

The [[long course]] (50 m pool) records were established in March 2014 and used the competition records from the [[World Aquatics Junior Swimming Championships|World Junior Championships]] as standard times.<ref name="Swimming World Magazine">{{cite magazine|title=FINA World Junior Records Can Begin Being Set Today|url=http://www.swimmingworldmagazine.com/lane9/news/World/38557.asp?q=FINA-World-Junior-Records-Can-Begin-Being-Set-Today|magazine=[[Swimming World Magazine]]|date=1 April 2014|access-date=2 April 2014|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140407102832/http://www.swimmingworldmagazine.com/lane9/news/World/38557.asp?q=FINA-World-Junior-Records-Can-Begin-Being-Set-Today|archive-date=7 April 2014}}</ref> 
[[Short course (swimming)|Short course]] (25 m pool) records were established on 1 January 2015, and were shortly followed by the release of "Junior World Bests," which served as standard times for each event.<ref>{{cite magazine|title=FINA Releases ‘Junior World Bests’ Short Course Standards In Order To Identify Junior World Records|url=https://swimswam.com/fina-releases-world-best-times-short-course-standards-order-identify-junior-world-record/|magazine=[[SwimSwam]]|author=Mitch Bowmile|date=6 January 2015|access-date=30 October 2025}}</ref> Initially, the age groups were 15 to 18 years for boys and 14 to 17 years for girls. In 2023, they were changed to 14 to 18 years for all athletes.<ref name=age>{{cite magazine|title=World Aquatics Shifts Ages of Eligibilty for Girls World Junior Records|url=https://swimswam.com/world-aquatics-shifts-ages-of-eligibilty-for-girls-world-junior-records/|magazine=[[SwimSwam]]|author=Braden Keith|date=8 March 2023|access-date=30 October 2025}}</ref>

Records are recognized for long course and short course in the following events:
*[[Freestyle swimming|freestyle]]: 50, 100, 200, 400, 800 and 1500;
*[[backstroke]]: 50, 100 and 200;
*[[breaststroke]]: 50, 100 and 200;
*[[Butterfly swimming|butterfly]]: 50, 100 and 200;
*[[Individual medley]]: 100 (short course only), 200 and 400;
*[[Relay race|relays]]: 4×50 freestyle (short course only), 4×100 freestyle, 4×200 freestyle, 4×50 medley (short course only) and 4×100 medley;
*Mixed relays: 4×100 freestyle (long course only), 4×50 medley (short course only) and 4×100 medley (long course only).

All records were swum in finals unless noted otherwise.
